entry.title: Hackerrank - SQL - Weather Observation Station 7
entry.summary:
https://github.com/mrpunkdasilva/hackerrank/tree/main/sql/basic/weather-observartion-station-7 Query the list of CITY names ending with vowels (a, e, i, o, u) from STATION. Your result cannot contain duplicates. The STATION table is described as follows:
Field Type
ID NUMBER
CITY VARCHAR2(21)
STATE VARCHAR2(2)
LAT_N NUMBER
LONG_W NUMBER
where LAT_N is the northern latitude and LONG_W is the western longitude. Use a SELECT statement with the DISTINCT keyword to retrieve unique CITY names Apply a WHERE clause with conditions:
Ensure LAT_N and LONG_W are not NULL Check if the last character of the CITY name is a vowel using the SUBSTRING function and the IN operator Start with the SELECT statement using DISTINCT to get unique city names:
SELECT DISTINCT CITY
Specify the table to query from:
FROM STATION
Add the WHERE clause with conditions:
Check for valid latitude and longitude values Use SUBSTRING with a negative index to extract the last character of each CITY name Convert it to lowercase with LOWER Check if it's a vowel using the IN operator
WHERE (LAT_N IS NOT NULL) AND (LONG_W IS NOT NULL) AND LOWER(SUBSTRING(CITY, -1)) IN ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u')
The final query:
SELECT DISTINCT CITY FROM STATION WHERE (LAT_N IS NOT NULL) AND (LONG_W IS NOT NULL) AND LOWER(SUBSTRING(CITY, -1)) IN ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u') ;
The query will return a list of unique city names from the STATION table where the last character is a vowel (a, e, i, o, or u).
